purpose: SFW assistant-surgeon role confirmation reward CG pack
shared_direction: Preserve each adult staff member's face, eye color, hair identity and established sterile clothing.
Use a coherent modern operating-room palette, crisp line art, detailed cel shading and cinematic cool light.
Keep the staff member attractive and anatomically correct, with no text, logo, watermark, blood, incision or exposed patient anatomy.

assets.prompt_summary: Calm teaching-style assistant confirmation; green eyes and oval glasses preserved; both sterile hands raised correctly at chest height in a bright operating room.
Decisive dynamic assistant confirmation; magenta eyes and hair identity preserved; one hand above the drape and one at chest height under crisp operating-room light.
Centered, authoritative chief-surgeon assistant confirmation; cool unwavering gaze and poised sterile hands in a darker teal operating room.

Attractive light-comedy confirmation: red hair and green eyes preserved; she freezes with both hands raised, a small sweat drop and a sliding gauze pack showing nervous inexperience without a dangerous accident.

future_runtime_contract.trigger: First successful assignment of the matching staff member to the assistant-surgeon role.
future_runtime_contract.playback: Show once immediately after assignment, then add permanently to Event Memories.
future_runtime_contract.repeat_behavior: Do not interrupt later assignments; replay only from Event Memories.
future_runtime_contract.persistence: Reward IDs are stored in the staff relationship unlocked_benefits list.
future_runtime_contract.content_boundary: This pack contains SFW generated CGs. User-supplied NSFW assets use separate source records and may share the same unlock/gallery framework.
